python_tests.command: python3 -m unittest tests.test_signet_checks tests.test_signet_proof tests.test_signet_load tests.test_signet_load_scale tests.test_signet_phase -v
python_tests.scope: Controller/native-proof contract tests using stub native/Core and the production backing-observation helper's classification; not live ChainReader transport, new live money or product qualification.

verified_boundaries: Only typed moving-chain observation retries; fixed 60-second reconciliation deadline
Original acknowledged native send exactly once; raw VTXO wallet read cached while signature proof observes fresh Core
No retry of signature FAILED, bad backing, timeout, unknown raw action, or expired deadline
Each failed/unavailable observation and retry permission remains in the journal
limits: No new public-Signet funded scale result
No new product API, fee cap, funds, actor, invoice, send or recovery operation
